title: POV: You Left My Reel On Seen
arc: send (hope) -> oblivious (first side-eye) -> seen-no-reaction (full stare) -> pivot (he saves them to watch together)
emotional_throughline: The reel is a tiny test of 'do my discoveries matter to you in real time?' The answer arrives late but better than asked: he saves them for shared time.
pov: Aachu sender-voice on slides 1-3; slide 4 softens to 'us'.
time_logic: Single evening. Slides 1-3 continuous on the sofa (minutes apart); slide 4 later the same night in bed/blanket. Wardrobe constant in 1-3; slide 4 may add the blanket but keeps the same clothes to prove same-day continuity.
comedy_mechanic: Escalating latency crimes acted entirely by Aachu's eyes; Zuv stays warmly oblivious, never villainous.
retention_mechanic: Camera distance closes wide -> mid -> extreme close, then releases wide on the pivot; each swipe changes shot size and crime severity.
